title: bufonia paniculata subsp. teneriffae
intro: Bufonia paniculata subsp. teneriffae, commonly known as Canary Island Bufonia, is a plant species that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its rich source of bioactive compounds that offer health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Bufonia paniculata subsp. teneriffae include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
